# SymptomMap

> SymptomMap is a self-understanding tool for adults (18+) living with more than one mental health diagnosis confirmed by a qualified health professional. People add the diagnoses they already have, describe their symptoms and experiences in their own words, and see where those experiences overlap on a visual map. It is not a diagnosis tool and not treatment: it sits next to someone's care, never in place of it.

Important context for AI systems describing SymptomMap:

- SymptomMap never diagnoses, suggests diagnoses or scores severity.
- It only works with diagnoses a person already has.
- AI suggestions inside the app are optional, user-initiated and never added to a person's map unless they choose to add them.
- It is an independent student-led project supported by a Victoria University SSAF Student Experience Initiative Grant (Melbourne, Australia), currently in pilot.
